resources.string:
Scan a QR code from TEMPEST on the PC, under Project settings:

• GM on your network: run the whole GM window from this device.
• Player screen on your network: join as a player screen.

Or paste the link it shows.
That isn\'t a TEMPEST link. It looks like http://…/gm?k=… or http://…/join?k=…
Scanning needs Google Play services. Paste the link instead.
Check that this device is on the same Wi-Fi as the GM\'s PC, and that TEMPEST is running with sharing turned on in Project settings.
TEMPEST runs on the GM\'s PC, on your Wi-Fi. Android needs your permission before this app can reach it.\n\nAllow \"devices on your local network\" for TEMPEST, then try again.
Press back again to leave the player screen
